summary: End-to-end validation of iteration 57: Impor Produk & Paket Bundling dengan Pratinjau + Label Rak. All 7 backend pytest cases passed (preview errors/warnings, dry_run saves nothing, commit saves only valid rows, update preserves stok, bulk bundles errors on bad SKU/qty/dup/empty name/no components/unknown channel, create+update case-insensitive, kasir 403 on both). Frontend: Daftar Harga -> Produk Satuan uploaded /app/frontend/public/Contoh_Produk.xlsx -> preview '5 baru, 0 diperbarui, 0 bermasalah', confirm saved all 5 and toast '5 produk baru, 0 diperbarui' shown. Bad-rows file (empty SKU + duplicate SKU) -> red Gagal rows with messages 'SKU kosong' and 'SKU ganda di file', confirm label 'Simpan 2 data valid'; Cancel saved nothing (row count unchanged). Label Rak button downloaded Label_Harga_Rak.pdf for the visible products. Paket Bundling tab: uploaded /app/frontend/public/Contoh_Paket_Bundling.xlsx -> preview '2 baru, 0 diperbarui, 0 bermasalah' with 2 components each; confirm created 2 bundles (Paket Pupuk Hemat 1x PPK-001 + 3x PPK-002 Rp 330.000; Paket Tanam Cabai 1x BNH-001 + 2x PPK-002 Rp 60.000) with Shopee channel prices applied. Kasir: 0 import/template buttons found on both Produk Satuan and Paket Bundling tabs - correctly hidden. All data cleaned up afterwards; final products=0, bundles=0.

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning: <span> rendered inside <option> at DaftarHarga.jsx line 110 (devtools injects x-source span). Non-blocking, carried from previous iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: bulk_products: duplicate-SKU-in-file detection added (seen set) - good; negative numbers, unknown channel, warnings for Harga Normal <= 0 / < Harga Beli all behave as spec.
bulk_products on update correctly pops stok and merges harga_channel so existing channel prices are preserved.
bulk_bundles correctly validates integer qty > 0, duplicate SKU within bundle, missing components list, empty name, unknown channel, and does case-insensitive upsert by name.
ImportPreviewDialog uses semantic data-testids (import-preview-dialog, -summary, -row-N, -cancel, -confirm) and disables confirm when there are 0 valid rows - solid UX.
readBundleExcel correctly groups rows with the same Nama Paket and continues previous bundle when Nama Paket is empty on subsequent rows (verified with Contoh file).
printShelfLabels generates compact 63x34mm labels with store name, product name, price and SKU - 3 cols x 8 rows per page. Toast error when sorted.length==0 - good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin preview+confirm+cancel+shelf+bundle import all pass; kasir correctly hidden)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests created TEST_* products/bundles (auto-cleaned via module fixture). UI test imported Contoh_Produk.xlsx + Contoh_Paket_Bundling.xlsx then DELETE API cleaned everything. Final products=0, bundles=0 as user requested.
